With the help of @BobZilla, I got this working. The instructions are below:

Navigate to the correct folder by using this command:
cd filenode

Then stop the docker container:
docker compose down

Then clear the cache folder:
rm -rf ~/filenode/cache/*

Then start the docker container:
docker compose up -d

Then to check if the chunks are being downloaded:
docker compose logs -f

There will be some failures, but you should get to 100% of the chunks downloaded eventually
